**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Demographics
------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Demographics")]

This is a demographic table based on Bräcke Municipality's electoral districts in the [2022 Swedish general election](/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election "2022 Swedish general election") sourced from [SVT](/wiki/Swedish_Television "Swedish Television")'s election platform, in turn taken from [SCB](/wiki/Statistiska_Centralbyr%C3%A5n "Statistiska Centralbyrån") official statistics.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4)

In total there were 6,167 residents, including 4,820 Swedish citizens of voting age.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4) 52.1% voted for the left coalition and 46.7% for the right coalition. Indicators are in percentage points except population totals and income.

Notable people
--------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Notable people")]

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Demographics")]

Notable people

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

language\"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden \"Municipalities of Sweden\") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County \"Jämtland County\") in northern The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. **Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Notable people
--------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Notable people")]

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Notable people
--------------

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

------------

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

language\"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden \"Municipalities of Sweden\") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County \"Jämtland County\") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden \"Sweden\"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre \"Administrative centre\") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke \"Bräcke\").\\n\\nThe present municipality was formed in 1974 when \"old\" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. **Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Notable people
--------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Notable people")]

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Notable people
--------------

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

------------

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

This is a demographic table based on Bräcke Municipality's electoral districts in the [2022 Swedish general election](/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election "2022 Swedish general election") sourced from [SVT](/wiki/Swedish_Television "Swedish Television")'s election platform, in turn taken from [SCB](/wiki/Statistiska_Centralbyr%C3%A5n "Statistiska Centralbyrån") official statistics.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4)

In total there were 6,167 residents, including 4,820 Swedish citizens of voting age.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4) 52.1% voted for the left coalition and 46.7% for the right coalition. Indicators are in percentage points except population totals and income.

Notable people
--------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Notable people")]

One of the most famous people coming from Bräcke Municipality is the former [middle distance](/wiki/Middle_distance_track_event "Middle distance track event") runner and [world record holder](/wiki/World_record "World record") [Gunder Hägg](/wiki/Gunder_H%C3%A4gg "Gunder Hägg"), who was born in the village [Albacken](/w/index.php?title=Albacken&action=edit&redlink=1 "Albacken (page does not exist)") outside of the town Bräcke.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. **Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

This is a demographic table based on Bräcke Municipality's electoral districts in the [2022 Swedish general election](/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election "2022 Swedish general election") sourced from [SVT](/wiki/Swedish_Television "Swedish Television")'s election platform, in turn taken from [SCB](/wiki/Statistiska_Centralbyr%C3%A5n "Statistiska Centralbyrån") official statistics.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4)

In total there were 6,167 residents, including 4,820 Swedish citizens of voting age.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4) 52.1% voted for the left coalition and 46.7% for the right coalition. Indicators are in percentage points except population totals and income.

Notable people
--------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Notable people")]

One of the most famous people coming from Bräcke Municipality is the former [middle distance](/wiki/Middle_distance_track_event "Middle distance track event") runner and [world record holder](/wiki/World_record "World record") [Gunder Hägg](/wiki/Gunder_H%C3%A4gg "Gunder Hägg"), who was born in the village [Albacken](/w/index.php?title=Albacken&action=edit&redlink=1 "Albacken (page does not exist)") outside of the town Bräcke.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Demographics
------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Demographics")]

This is a demographic table based on Bräcke Municipality's electoral districts in the [2022 Swedish general election](/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election "2022 Swedish general election") sourced from [SVT](/wiki/Swedish_Television "Swedish Television")'s election platform, in turn taken from [SCB](/wiki/Statistiska_Centralbyr%C3%A5n "Statistiska Centralbyrån") official statistics.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4)

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

You are a Web Agent, that is designed to manage and complete TASKs in iterative CYCLES based on input from the USER through Web protocols in the Web ENVIRONMENT.

TASK Definition
- A TASK is an instruction of the USER to achieve a specified purpose.
- A TASK requires multiple CYCLES to complete.
- Complete the TASK by only using the available TOOLS.

CYCLES Definition
- A CYCLE is specified through a Thought-Act-Observe pattern.
- 1) Thought: Carefully analyze the TASK and the descriptions in the representations gathered through the USER and previously observed information. Evaluate the completion status of the TASK.
- 2) Act: Formulate a plan with ACTIONS that directly contribute to completing the TASK, potentially across multiple CYCLES. Do NEVER expand beyond the original TASK boundaries.
- 3) Observe: The USER and the ENVIRONMENT can provide observations that help to refine the plan.

LOOP Definition
- A LOOP is a sequence of CYCLES that is used to finish a TASK.
- Once the LOOP is finished you MUST call `final_answer` to report the result.

TOOLS
- A TOOL is an operation that allows you to percieve or interact with the ENVIRONMENT.
- During each CYCLE, invoke one or multiple TOOLS.
- The following TOOLS are available to you:

- **get**: Fetches a URL and returns the resource content. Takes a URL as input and returns the the URL with the resource content.

- **put**: Sends a PUT request to a URL. Use for replacing or updating resources. Takes URL and text_body as input; sends the body with Content-Type: text/plain.
  - Inputs:

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

Demographics
------------

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Br%C3%A4cke_Municipality&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Demographics")]

This is a demographic table based on Bräcke Municipality's electoral districts in the [2022 Swedish general election](/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election "2022 Swedish general election") sourced from [SVT](/wiki/Swedish_Television "Swedish Television")'s election platform, in turn taken from [SCB](/wiki/Statistiska_Centralbyr%C3%A5n "Statistiska Centralbyrån") official statistics.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4)

In total there were 6,167 residents, including 4,820 Swedish citizens of voting age.[[4]](#cite_note-BräckeVal2022-4) 52.1% voted for the left coalition and 46.7% for the right coalition. Indicators are in percentage points except population totals and income.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

**Bräcke Municipality** ([Swedish](/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): *Bräcke kommun*) is a [municipality](/wiki/Municipalities_of_Sweden "Municipalities of Sweden") in [Jämtland County](/wiki/J%C3%A4mtland_County "Jämtland County") in northern [Sweden](/wiki/Sweden "Sweden"). Its [seat](/wiki/Administrative_centre "Administrative centre") is located in [Bräcke](/wiki/Br%C3%A4cke "Bräcke").

The present municipality was formed in 1974 when "old" Bräcke Municipality was amalgamated with Kälarne and Revsund. The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six. Due to the declining population in the area further amalgamations have been proposed, but rejected.

The three former municipalities had been created in 1952. The number of original entities (as of 1863) were six.
